modalities.evidence: daily 30-minute resting-state functional MRI scans before, during and after casting
resting-state functional MRI data in each individual

output.population: Three healthy adult participants who wore a cast covering the entire right upper extremity for two weeks
output.summary: Three healthy adults wore a cast on the right upper extremity for two weeks and were scanned daily with resting-state functional MRI before, during and after casting, plus a movement task and a control experiment.
